description:
ScreenMotion is a native iPhone theme studio for original motion scenes, coordinated icons, and widgets you can save and install yourself.

Browse sixteen original scenes across vehicles, aquariums, space, and nature. Preview every world for free, then personalize color, motion, and framing before you export.

Exports stay under your control. Save a still wallpaper, a short video, or a Live Photo, then apply it through iOS. Four starter scenes are free. ScreenMotion Pro unlocks the full catalog, icon packs, and exports.

ScreenMotion Pro is an auto-renewing monthly or yearly subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. Unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, the subscription renews automatically. Manage or cancel in Apple ID subscription settings. Restore Purchases is available in the app.
